# Complex dynamics library

Build reusable mathematics for holomorphic dynamics. Functions and local limits
should have their actual domains where practical. The sphere is the one-point
compactification of the plane; an entire map is not assigned a value at infinity.

The project maintainer is Lasse Rempe. Adapted material from LR-UK/exp-chaotic
must retain attribution and its Apache licence. Preserve the pinned toolchain.

Only finished proofs belong in the library. Never use proof holes, extra axioms,
unchecked computation, or assumptions that conceal the result being requested.
Audit headline theorems for the standard axioms propext, Classical.choice,
and Quot.sound. Update STATUS.md with actual checked results and remaining work.

Do not publish or contact collaborators without explicit user authorization.
